intents.text:
Rishabh is **Sr. AI Researcher at Simplilearn** in Bengaluru, a role he's held since March 2026. He leads hands-on research into emerging AI technology and turns it into automation for the business — agentic orchestration, multi-step workflow automation, open-source work, and prototypes of new tech as it emerges.

His strongest proof so far: he built an N8N-based multi-agent "Collaterals Agent" that cut course-launch collateral creation from 7–10 days to one day, and the team won Simplilearn's Best Team Award (Q3).

Want his full résumé? It's at [/resume](/resume).

Stage one screens vitals and symptoms; stage two adds chest X-ray analysis for a deeper diagnosis.
